title: Build views on demand and check them in CI
goal: Parallel PRs no longer conflict on a generated file
acceptance: A `workItems` setting selects committed or built views; built views are written by `work-items build` and ignored by git
`check:work`, `check:backlog` and the dependency and queue checks run on the sources and a fresh build in CI
Fixture tests for both modes; the default stays committed views until the transition ends
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A check that reads a committed view and would pass on a stale one is a design defect

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25: `workItems.views` (committed default, built), check builds fresh in built mode, CI step order; unreleased until F-096-T06. Review and CI remain.
